name: Defold · html5-bundle
note: One zipped Defold project dropped into a project's drop/ folder becomes one HTML5 bundle in out/. The lane runs bob.jar (pinned to engine sha 574678c7, Defold 1.13.1) under Defold's own JDK 25 in three steps; the engine.run receipt cites the input, the bundle zip, the platform actually used and the Defold env-lock.

rows.label: project
rows.note: game.project at the zip root (or inside one top-level folder); no native extensions needed

rows.label: staged
rows.note: a bare game.project or a zip not named *.defold.zip is staged, never built (rules: stage)

rows.label: 1 unpack
rows.note: run.mjs unpack · title, source files, declared dependencies, native extensions

rows.label: 3 bundle
rows.value: bob --platform wasm-web --architectures wasm-web --archive --variant release build bundle
rows.note: run.mjs bundle · prebuilt engine from bob.jar, no build server; falls back to the host platform and says so

rows.label: 4 pack
rows.note: bob's <title>/ folder renamed, zipped, every file hashed

rows.label: bundle
rows.note: index.html · dmloader.js · <title>_wasm.js · <title>.wasm · archive/ (directory; not hashed by the lane)

rows.label: bundle-zip
rows.note: bundle · {stem}.macos.zip when the report says fallback

rows.label: report
rows.note: platform, fallback, files+bytes+sha256, engine sha, bob version, java used, build server

rows.label: cites
rows.value: input sha256 · zip sha256 · env-lock sha256 · template shas
rows.note: sealed in the root store by the lane

rows.label: extra
rows.value: platform · fallback · bundle_files · bundle_bytes · engine_sha · bob_version · build_server

rows.label: acceptance
rows.value: bundle folder complete · zip + report hashed · receipt cites input, outputs, platform, env-lock
